scope: Public GitHub Release, checksum manifest, exact-file VirusTotal observations, workflow SHA lint and website links; no application binary or dependency changes.

virusTotal.scope: Public VirusTotal submission and completed SHA-256 matching reports; these are observations at the stated time, not a safety guarantee.

preflight.scope: Distribution-only follow-up; identical existing binaries, no dependency/lock, engine, DB or global security-setting changes.

checks.name: Environment and secrets
checks.evidence: GitHub short-lived platform token scoped to release upload; no personal token or secret contents read.

checks.name: Errors
checks.evidence: Stale checksum rejected with exit 1 before replacing site output; valid input exits 0. Existing release/tag absent.

checks.name: Inputs
checks.evidence: Current three artifact sizes/hashes and canonical checksum content verified; both VirusTotal reports match actual SHA-256.

checks.name: Authorization
checks.evidence: User requested public Release/checksum/VirusTotal; temporary publisher requests contents:write, persist-credentials:false; no engine operation.

checks.name: DB migration
checks.evidence: No app code, metadata schema, engine or user DB change.

checks.name: Monitoring
checks.evidence: Public file reports, observation times and timeout/unsupported engine counts retained; workflow outcome to be checked.

checks.name: Tests
checks.evidence: Site build and meaningful stale-checksum failure passed; app tests are the earlier 0.1.7 record, not rerun for this distribution-only change.

checks.name: Rate limits
checks.evidence: Static public files, two manual VirusTotal submissions; no new runtime API or polling.

checks.name: Security and performance
checks.evidence: EXE 0/66 with four timeout/five unsupported; ZIP 0/67 with seven unsupported. Unsigned build; no safety guarantee or new code-signing claim.

checks.name: Rollback
checks.evidence: Existing Pages file URLs and historical legal archives retained; no tag force/update or existing release replacement. Release/site rollback not rehearsed.

workflowPinLint.ciScope: All pull requests and main pushes; Pages additionally requires its own successful pin-check job before build/deploy.

remaining: Actual installer/uninstaller and long-running load were not repeated
VirusTotal EXE: four timeout and five unsupported; ZIP: seven unsupported
